content.title: What Are the Gospels? A Comparison with Graeco-Roman Biography
content.author: Richard A. Burridge (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1992; 2nd edn Grand Rapids: Eerdmans, 2004)
content.note: Compares the Gospels with ancient lives (bioi) by their features and concludes that they belong to that genre, which aimed to portray a real person. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
